targets.context: an AI story chat service name appearing in an English article about a Japanese manga app
brand name in 'LINE Manga' (Japanese messaging/manga app)

items.unconfirmed_reason: Official English material identifies the service but does not state its pronunciation. No verifiable official English pronunciation audio or video was found.
items.quote: We are leveraging AI to create more interactive experiences through innovations like byUs, our interactive story chat service
items.ambiguity_note: The quoted official English release and WEBTOON's English shareholder letter use byUs without phonetic guidance. English coverage in Seoul Economic Daily and Eigen Radar likewise does not state a pronunciation. The official Japanese launch announcement supplies byUs（バイアス）, but that is Japanese-only reading evidence and cannot establish an English pronunciation. The quote above identifies the product; it is not pronunciation evidence. ([ir.webtoon.com](https://ir.webtoon.com/news-releases/news-release-details/webtoon-entertainment-inc-reports-second-quarter-2026-financial))

items.unconfirmed_reason: No explicit official English pronunciation statement or verifiable official English spoken pronunciation was found in the sources accessible during this search.
items.ambiguity_note: The official English homepage supplies the brand spelling but no pronunciation guidance. An official conference announcement explains the pronunciation of LIVER in LINE LIVERs, not LINE itself. Cambridge gives /laɪn/ for the ordinary English word line, but that entry does not establish the company's official brand pronunciation. The official LINE Global YouTube channel was opened, but no usable spoken-pronunciation evidence was accessible. The quote above is branding text, not pronunciation evidence. ([line.me](https://line.me/en/))
